## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior or documentation.

## Validation

Include the results of `python3 tools/check_repository.py`, `python3 evaluation/tools/check_design.py`, and `python3 -m unittest discover -s evaluation/tests -v`.

## Current evaluation scope

Identify the affected OpenClaw dimension: reliability, security, performance, resource usage/cost, extensibility, or observability. Distinguish plan/fixture validation from actual product execution and link independent evidence for product claims.

## Archive impact

State whether archived files, experiment behavior, dependency pins, or provenance changed. For a packaging-only change, explain why the original experiment inputs remain intact.
